sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bulk Vessel Brokerage of Agricultural Soybeans and Yellow Corn

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage under the Constitution of Samoa and Judicature Ordinance Act 1961, supplemented by Samoan custom/usage in limited customary matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) with Australia and New Zealand
TIEAs and exchange-of-information instruments concluded with OECD jurisdictions pursuant to Samoa's 2009 international commitments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017 (Samoa), as amended, read with the Financial Intelligence Unit's AML/CFT directives; International Companies Act 2014 (Samoa) as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 (beneficial ownership and registered agent duties); Crimes Act 2016 (money laundering and financing of terrorism offences); United Nations Act 2016 (implementation of UN Security Council sanctions); International Companies Regulations 2014.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the valid national passport (or other Government-issued photo identification) of every Ultimate Beneficial Owner, director and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport/ID issuing authority in the UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Samoa is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; the document is notarized, then certified by the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade or the nearest Samoan consular post)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter for each UBO and for the proposed International Company, issued within 90 days, confirming identity, account conduct and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated commercial bank maintaining the UBO's/company's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Source of Wealth statement executed by each UBO, including the corporate chain chart and ownership percentage breakdown
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD per AML/CFT Act 2017: every UBO, director and signatory must be screened against the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic sanctions/UN sanctions list, OFAC SDN List, FATF public statements, INTERPOL notices and international PEP databases. PEP relationships require senior-management approval, enhanced continuous monitoring and, where warranted, STR filing with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit. All screenings are documented, date-stamped and retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - International Companies Registry (via licensed registered agents; online name clearance facilitated through the MCIL Companies Office 'Konekta' business portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name may be in English, Samoan, or a Roman-alphabet transliteration of any foreign language; Chinese or other non-Roman script names are not accepted as the statutory registered name but may appear as an optional Chinese-language alias in the memorandum of association. The name must include a format token from the prescribed list (e.g., Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, Societe Anonyme).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Building Society / Savings and Loan / Credit Union
Any token suggesting licensing, professional qualifications, or connection with the Samoan Government or a foreign state
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registered agent shall request written reasons from the Registrar of International Companies, submit a revised name application, or apply for an extension of a valid clearance before expiry by lodging the prescribed extension form and fee with the MCIL Registrar. Where the Registrar continues to refuse, the applicant may file a written administrative review within 14 days of the refusal with the Registrar, then escalate to the Chief Executive Officer of MCIL, and ultimately seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa under common-law administrative law grounds (procedural unfairness, error of law, or unreasonableness).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only through the statutory registered-agent structure: the International Company must maintain its registered office at the physical address of a licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; a standalone virtual mailbox cannot satisfy the International Companies Act 2014. All overseas commercial brokerage activities may be administered electronically from outside Samoa.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated 5% annual probability. Unannounced physical inspections under the International Companies Act 2014 and AML/CFT Act 2017 target the licensed registered agent's premises and records in Samoa, not the overseas operational offices of the offshore company.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance search and reservation fee (International Companies Registry)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory MCIL fee tariff for name search and reservation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (Government fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act 2014 and Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent engagement fee for Stage 1 due diligence and KYC file compilation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed agents under AML/CFT Act 2017

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address provision (annual, assessment only in stage 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark tariff for registered-office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register setup, corporate-chain chart preparation and declaration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML/CFT Act 2017 obligation; prevailing professional compliance fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of UBO declarations, source-of-wealth statements and constitutional documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee scale applicable in the issuer's locale

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of notarized document sets (Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and relevant consular post)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade / destination consulate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC SDN, UN sanctions and FATF screening database subscription (annualized apportionment for Stage 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial screening data provider / compliance manager

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2012 (Samoa), principally ss. 4-9, 12-15, 22 and 25; International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2013; Companies Act 2008 is residual only for matters not expressly modified for international companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-01 or electronic equivalent), accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; the Act permits zero issued capital or one or more shares at any consideration, and no escrow account or capital deposit must be established
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: 1. The subscriber adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association and subscribes for the initial ordinary shares at the stated issue price. 2. The registered office in Samoa is fixed, and the licensed registered agent is appointed for service of process. 3. The persons named as sole or additional directors and as company secretary are appointed to hold office until replaced. 4. The directors are authorized to open bank accounts, engage commodity brokers and execute all sale, purchase and administrative contracts. 5. The registered agent is instructed to file the incorporation application and thereafter to maintain statutory records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation via a licensed registered agent or MCIL Companies Online portal; check for confusing similarity, prohibited names and restricted suffixes; reserve the selected English or Chinese official name with the required corporate suffix.
required_dossiers: Consent letter if the proposed name contains a restricted word (bank, trust, insurance, etc.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects on similarity or restricted grounds, select a clearly different name and resubmit the reservation; an objection to surname-only distinctions is cured by adding a distinctive element to the name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Samoa, advised by legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association for an exempted international company, incorporating permitted objects, share provisions, director indemnity and the Chinese-language version if desired; the subscriber and initial directors execute the documents before a notary or equivalent officer.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director from each proposed director
Consent to act as company secretary if applicable
Notarized or legalized identity documents of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A defect in notarization or illegible signature is cured by re-executing the page and re-attaching the notarial certificate; changes to objects require a supplemental resolution before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of registered agent and establishment of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company appoints a licensed registered agent physically present in Samoa and designates a registered office in Samoa for official correspondence and service of process; the agent's consent and address confirmation are filed.
required_dossiers: Certificate of the agent's current MCIL licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen agent is not on the MCIL list of licensed agents, appoint an eligible licensed agent and execute a replacement appointment letter, then resubmit the consent form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of application and payment of statutory fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the incorporation application electronically or in paper form, together with the constitutional documents and statutory declarations of compliance, and pays the prescribed government fee by bank payment into the Samoa Consolidated Fund.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent files a formal response within 14 days and amends any clerical error; if the Registrar refuses, a fresh corrected application is made after eliminating the stated ground of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation naming the International Company, its number and date of incorporation; the registered agent verifies the certificate against the filed articles and records the entity in the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by MCIL
Approved Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A typographical mismatch in name, number or date is corrected by a written request to the Registrar together with the certificate and a corrective statement; the certificate is reissued with the same effective date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and corporate governance pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors; corporate secretary; company records maintained by registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold a first board meeting by physical attendance or written resolution to approve the share allotment, appoint officers, adopt the registered office and open the company seal; issue share certificates and open the statutory minute book, share register and charges register.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolutions of the first board meeting
Share certificate stubs and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A defect in the corporate records is cured by a supplemental board resolution corrected as of the later date; late recording of share transfers is acceptable if no transfer was executed before the record date, but the register is rectified promptly.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; the commercial activity is bulk vessel brokerage of agricultural commodities, which does not carry a separate industrial licensing requirement in Samoa. General corporate and trade licensing oversight is vested in the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt from operating licence; the incorporation certificate under the International Companies Act 2012 is the sole authorization required for the brokerage activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (PUMA/MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category not triggered; the activity involves no land disturbance, construction, manufacturing discharge or natural resource extraction, so no EIA report, development consent or environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable in the absence of physical plant. If warehousing, grain handling or vessel loading is later established, the operator would fall under the Water Resources Management Act 2008 for effluent standards, the Waste Management Act 2005 for solid waste and the National Air Quality and Emissions Standards for fugitive grain dust and engine emissions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire service or civil-defense permit is triggered for a pure brokerage office. Any physical premises must maintain building-occupancy compliance and evacuation plans under the National Building Code and the Fire and Emergency Services Act, and the office must satisfy basic occupational health, first aid and electrical safety standards under the Labour and Workplace Relations Act 2013.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa (Matagaluega o Tupe Maua), Apia, Samoa. The Ministry is the single national tax and customs administration responsible for VAGST, income tax, stamp duty, and customs duty. Taxpayer-facing services are accessible through the Ministry of Revenue's online e-Services portal (Samoa Revenue Online Services), and customs lodgements are effected via the ASYCUDA World single-window system at Apia and the principal seaports and airport.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident beneficial owner of a Samoa International Company (IC): (1) appoint a licensed registered agent in Samoa as mandated under the International Companies Act 1987-1988; (2) file the memorandum and articles of association and the registered office/registered agent particulars with the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA); (3) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and pay the prescribed government incorporation and annual license fees; (4) obtain, where commercially prudent, a written tax-exemption or non-residence confirmation from the Ministry of Revenue evidencing that the IC is outside the Samoan income tax and VAGST net; and (5) note that no separate Samoan TIN is required for the offshore brokerage business. Only if the IC transacts taxable supplies within Samoa must it obtain a TIN from the Ministry of Revenue, register for VAGST once turnover reaches the threshold, and secure a domestic Business Licence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutory offshore exemption; the IC is treated as a non-resident, tax-exempt entity in respect of all non-Samoan-source trading income and is prohibited from carrying on business with Samoan residents without forfeiting its exempt status).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elective classification exists in Samoan law; the exemption of an International Company is statutory and automatic, not elective. The only material election is the surrender/revocation of exempt status: an IC may file a notice with SIFA under the International Companies Act 1987-1988 to convert into an ordinary domestic company, after which it becomes fully liable under the Income Tax Act 2010 and the VAGST Act 2008, and must obtain a Business Licence and register for VAGST when threshold turnover is reached. Samoa has not enacted dedicated hybrid-mismatch legislation beyond its BEPS Inclusive Framework commitments, so tax planning is confined to the statutory IC exemption and cannot duplicate deductions through hybrid instruments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax), governed by the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008, as amended.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 / WS$ 100,000 (Samoan Tala) of annual taxable supplies for a person carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa. A tax-exempt International Company engaged in offshore bulk grain brokerage of soybeans and yellow corn is outside the scope of VAGST because the supply of cargo brokerage services is performed entirely outside Samoa.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or continuous-transaction-control e-invoicing mandate is currently in force in Samoa. The Ministry of Revenue operates an e-filing platform (Samoa Revenue Online Services) for TIN/VAGST administration, and all customs declarations must be lodged electronically in ASYCUDA World, but B2B invoices remain paper/PDF based. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue tax invoices containing the prescribed particulars; there is no government API requirement for real-time invoice clearing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Samoa are zero-rated, and services supplied to non-residents or performed entirely outside Samoa are zero-rated or otherwise outside the territorial scope of VAGST. For the Samoa IC (bulk vessel brokerage for soybeans (HS 1201) and yellow corn (HS 1005)), commission income from chartering and brokerage services negotiated and performed offshore is not subject to 15% VAGST; a VAGST-registered supplier claiming the 0% rate must demonstrate that the recipient is a non-resident not registered for VAGST in Samoa and that the service is consumed outside Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document lodged in ASYCUDA World) for any goods physically transiting Samoan ports
Bill of Lading or Sea Waybill, supported by the Charter Party, evidencing ocean shipment of the bulk grain cargo
Commercial Invoice and Packing List describing the soybeans/corn, quantity, grade, vessel, and consignee terms
Certificate of Origin and Phytosanitary Certificate (where the destination customs regime requires them)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT advice proving the export proceeds have been received through a licensed bank in Samoa in accordance with exchange-control requirements
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating is granted only on satisfactory documentary proof. In audit, if the exporter cannot substantiate the physical export or the offshore-recipient supply, the Ministry of Revenue retrospectively cancels the zero rating, assesses VAGST at 15%, imposes statutory late-payment interest, and recovers any refund paid. Deliberately false declarations by brokers or exporters attract evasion penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012 (commonly up to 200% of the evaded tax) and criminal fines or imprisonment, while false customs export declarations may additionally trigger penal duties, forfeiture of cargo, or suspension of customs electronic lodgement privileges. The limitation period for reopening assessments and clawing back fraudulently claimed export refunds is generally four years, extended in cases of fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBOS), acting as the Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) operates under a managed float with exchange control administered by CBOS. Current account payments are generally permitted through authorized dealers (commercial banks), but supporting documentation and approved transaction purpose codes are required. Capital account transfers, including inbound equity injections, shareholder loans, and profit remittances by Samoan resident entities, require prior CBOS approval or must be processed through a licensed Samoa commercial bank under delegated exchange-control authority. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 and classified as non-resident is treated as outside the Samoa exchange-control perimeter for its wholly offshore business; however, once an IC transacts in WST, maintains a domestic tala account, or receives funds into Samoa, convertibility is subject to the standard current/capital account review, meaning dividend and branch remittance requests must be supported by audited financial statements, tax status certificates, and a duly completed CBOS exchange-application form.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exported from Samoa, export proceeds must be repatriated to a licensed Samoan bank within 30 days of the date of export and 100% of the proceeds must be surrendered for WST at the prevailing market exchange rate unless CBOS has granted a specific retention or conversion exemption. This regime applies to Samoan-sourced exports of goods or commodities. For the WS_IC bulk grain and soybean/corn trading entity, the underlying goods are foreign-sourced and transshipped outside Samoa; accordingly, no statutory surrender obligation applies for the offshore contract proceeds, provided the IC does not maintain residency, the board and management are non-resident, and no funds are remitted into Samoa in settlement of the underlying trade.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (Samoa) Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI and e-money institutions are not licensed, registered, or recognized by the Central Bank of Samoa; therefore, no licensed Samoan clearing relationship can be established through an EMI. A WS_IC may maintain foreign-currency funds with an overseas EMI solely for non-Samoan operating payments, but this raises source-of-funds and sub-account scrutiny during any later Samoa banking onboarding. Samoan banks will not treat EMI statements as sufficient evidence of trade settlement, historical transactions, or beneficial-ownership proof.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, all licensed Samoa commercial banks require at least one natural-person director or a board-appointed authorized signatory to attend an in-person identity verification interview at the bank's Samoa branch or an acceptable foreign correspondent bank. Remote-only onboarding is not available as a standard product for a newly formed IC. However, if the Bank has a regional relationship or a pre-existing corporate client relationship, a video-based identity interview can be used as a preliminary step, followed by courier-certified notarized attestations and completion of the bank's account-mandate form before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO jurisdiction or nationality nexus with a FATF-listed or high-risk jurisdiction, causing automatic enhanced due diligence and potential refusal
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial-ownership declaration; jurisdiction-of-residence certification from a licensed tax or legal advisor; passport and proof-of-residence for each UBO; two independent trade references from established commodity counterparties; a flow chart of corporate ownership and the economic purpose of the Samoan IC; source-of-wealth evidence covering the initial contribution, including bank statements, share-sale agreements, audited entity financials, and tax returns if the UBO is operating through an operating company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Misclassification of bulk soybean and corn brokerage as a 'high-risk' dealer in virtual assets or commodities without tangible supply-chain documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 4631 and NAICS 424510 classification memo issued by a reputable compliance consultant; signed master agreements with suppliers and end-buyers; at least three recent commercial invoices, bills of lading, and weight certificates for soybean or yellow corn cargoes; insurance certificates for the transported goods; a clear audit trail of the physical flow of bulk agricultural commodities, including vessel/port and storage records, to demonstrate the genuinely operational nature of the brokerage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear or unverifiable source of initial paid-in capital or of the foreign-currency funds passing through the IC's operational account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholders' bank statement showing the exact wire origin; the signed board resolution approving the capital injection; a notarized share-subscription agreement; if funded by a shareholder loan, a notarized loan agreement with an amortization schedule; audited or certified financial statements of the lending shareholder; proof of economic capacity (tax returns, dividend records, disposal-of-asset contracts); and a sworn affidavit from the IC's directors confirming the absence of any related-party money laundering or terrorist-financing nexus.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing for a WS_IC capital injection or shareholder loan is typically a SWIFT MT103/MT202 message from the contributor's bank to a Samoa licensed commercial bank's correspondent account, using the account-holder name, the IC, and the purpose code 'Capital contribution to non-resident International Company.' The receiving Samoa bank must obtain the standard exchange-control declaration if funds are to be converted to WST or credited to a WST account; if held in a non-resident foreign-currency account, CBOS approval is not required. Supporting verification includes an updated corporate register extract, board resolution authorizing the issuance of shares, share-script, and UBO confirmation prepared within 30 days before the wire date.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rails for outbound settlement are: (1) Irrevocable Transferable Letters of Credit issued by the Samoan bank in favor of the grain supplier, routed SWIFT MT700, with a second bank advising or confirming the LC; (2) Direct SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for open-account post-shipment settlement, accompanied by the underlying invoice, bill of lading, and inspection certificate; and (3) Standby LC or bank guarantee (MT760) to secure performance obligations. Where the underlying trade does not touch Samoa, the commercial bank may permit the IC to issue payment instructions to correspondents under an offshore treasury account, but the bank will require the IC to maintain a compliant club-per-item trade file for six years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot and forward contracts in USD/WST executed with the Samoa licensed commercial bank for a maximum tenor of 12 months, supported by a signed underlying grain-purchase or sale contract

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in WST/USD, permitted when the Samoa bank or its correspondent determines that WST deliverability is unavailable at settlement, but only for a bona-fide commercial exposure in bulk grains
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST for matching the IC's trade receivable and trade payable cash-flow legs, subject to CBOS-required underlying transaction documentation and quarterly reporting
Currency options purchased (no uncovered option writing for a non-resident IC) on a principal-to-principal basis for hedging freight- or price-exposure on the soybean and corn portfolio

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company together with payment of the annual government licence fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the licensed registered agent files and disburses the fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to 10% per month of the unpaid fee; continued default for more than 6 months may trigger administrative strike-off of the company and cancellation of the registered agent's authority.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is generally required for a Samoa International Company. A compulsory independent audit is triggered only if the company is listed on a recognised stock exchange, holds a financial services licence issued by the Samoa International Financial Authority, or shareholders representing not less than 10% of the issued voting shares requisition an audit under the International Companies Act 2012.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies Act 2012; accounting records must be maintained at the registered office sufficient to reflect transactions and financial position. Voluntarily prepared financial statements are normally prepared under IFRS or Samoa equivalent GAAP, but statutory public filing of financial statements does not apply for exempt international companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must keep a current register of beneficial owners at the registered office and verify ownership against the annual return each anniversary. A confirmation of beneficial ownership is completed at the time of the annual return; changes in shareholding during the year must be notified to the registered agent within 14 days, but the UBO register is not publicly filed with the Registrar.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400 - US$800 per annum, depending on the licensed agent and services selected
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500 - US$4,000 for a voluntary certified audit of a low-risk agricultural commodity brokerage company

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Companies (IC) under the International Companies Act 2007 tax exemption
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Samoa income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, estate duty, gift duty, and dividend withholding tax on all international trading and brokerage income, provided the IC conducts no Samoa domestic business and owns no Samoan land. Annual government fee is payable but no VAT/GST registration is triggered for offshore brokerage activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No annual corporate income tax return; the IC files an Annual Return with the Registrar of International Companies in Samoa through its licensed registered agent, and pays the prescribed annual government fee via the Samoa International Finance Authority portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee is due on the same anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, International Company number, date of incorporation, registered office address in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Samoa registered agent's address; no Samoan business address is permitted if the IC is to retain tax-exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, nationality, residential or business address, appointment and resignation dates of each director and secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permissible; provide a service address for each director if the residential address is private.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Shareholders and Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, shareholder names, class of shares, and consideration paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the IC; minimum capital is nil; shares may be issued in any currency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D - Registered Agent and Charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Samoa registered agent, registered office, and particulars of any registered charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoa-licensed agent is mandatory at all times; discharge of charges should be filed promptly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the registered agent confirming that the IC has not carried on business with Samoa residents, does not own Samoan land, and remains entitled to the statutory tax exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent will rely on written directors' confirmation; a false declaration revokes the exemption and triggers Samoa tax liabilities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment surcharge of 10% per month on the annual government fee; automatic administrative strike-off after 90 days of default; reinstatement requires payment of arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee; continuing failure may lead to dissolution of the IC with directors jointly liable for outstanding state charges.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions made by a tax-exempt International Company to both resident and non-resident shareholders under the International Companies Act 2007 exemption. A domestic dividend withholding tax of 15% would apply only if the IC loses its exempt status and becomes taxable as a Samoa domestic company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because the IC is tax-exempt, it is normally not a treaty-resident person entitled to benefits. If an exceptional cross-border payment becomes subject to Samoa withholding tax, the non-resident recipient must: (1) obtain a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate from the Ministry of Revenue authorizing the treaty rate; (2) submit the certificate and the prescribed DTA claim form to the payer before payment; and (3) disclose and prove beneficial ownership of the payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Exempt IC: 0% withholding on interest and royalties paid or received by the IC. Standard Samoa non-resident withholding rates if the IC exemption is unavailable: 10% on interest and 15% on royalties; applicable DTA rates may reduce or eliminate these amounts depending on the treaty partner and the terms of the relevant double tax agreement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory Local File or Master File threshold applies to a tax-exempt IC under Samoa law; prudent transfer pricing documentation should be retained for any related-party brokerage commission or commodity-supply transaction exceeding WST 250,000 (approximately USD 95,000) to defend the arm's length result in an audit or tax-exemption review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies conducting relevant activities. Bulk grain, soybean, and yellow corn brokerage is treated as a distribution and service centre activity; the IC must demonstrate: (i) a physical office and licensed registered agent in Samoa; (ii) effective management and control exercised in Samoa through local board meetings; (iii) adequate local qualified employees; and (iv) sufficient local operating expenditure. Failure to satisfy the economic substance test results in penalties up to WST 500,000, automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, and potential strike-off of the IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abuse of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a purportedly tax-exempt Samoa IC to earn income sourced from Samoa, such as brokerage services performed for Samoan domestic buyers or sellers, or holding Samoan land, while failing to register and file as a domestic taxpayer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of back taxes at the prevailing corporate rate plus penalty of up to 100% and statutory interest; criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act with fines up to WST 500,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly arranged the sham are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid taxes; courts may pierce the corporate veil, order civil restitution of diverted profits, impose travel bans, and imprison directors if fraud is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a pure shell with no physical presence, no local meetings, no employees, and no expenditure while claiming tax exemption and receiving commission income from the bulk grain trade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Annual penalty up to WST 500,000 under Samoa's economic substance regime, possible penalty based on gross income, compulsory reporting to foreign tax authorities, and deregistration by the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents may be individually fined up to WST 100,000; a director who certifies false economic substance information may be barred from managing an International Company for 5 years and may face a travel ban pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the brokerage IC to receive Swift wire proceeds from irrevocable transferable letters of credit while misrepresenting the end buyer, falsifying vessel bills of lading, or layering funds to disguise commodity-sale proceeds derived from sanctions evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under Samoa's Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Act: fines up to WST 2 million, forfeiture of proceeds, and imprisonment up to 15 years; implicated banks may be fined and de-risked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors involved in laundering or predicate fraud are personally criminally liable; assets can be traced and confiscated, director passports may be seized through court-ordered travel bans, and principal offenders face imprisonment of 10-15 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Invoice Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recording artificial intercompany commission rates, such as 20% commission on bulk corn or soybean cargoes, without CUP evidence, or issuing circular invoices to manipulate profit margins and obtain prepayments from unrelated grain houses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment of taxable profit, if any, plus late-payment interest; administrative penalty of up to 100% of understated tax; criminal fraud penalties of WST 500,000 if invoices are used to support fraudulent letter-of-credit draws.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false invoices and tax or transfer pricing declarations may be made personally liable for adjusted tax amounts; serious mispricing involving fraud exposes them to civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 7 years.
